theorems.statement: ∀ (P m r : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (v : Euclid m), 1 ≤ r → IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ r ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → (∀ x ∈ N, (Q x : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace N x) → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (ψ v) → v ∈ V → 0 < Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single l 1))) ∧ Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (Φ ∘ ψ) v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ (Φ ∘ ψ) v (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) = Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (Q (ψ v))) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ v) (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q (ψ v)) i)) (fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ v) (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q (ψ v)) j)))) * Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ ψ v (EuclideanSpace.single l 1))))
